findings.detail: The extracted maturity date is 2024-10-31, but the matching source row states the Price Fx Inc. loan is due 10/2029.

rationale: The flagged holding slice contains Price Fx Inc. with cost 921 and fair value 919, matching source table 35 row 19. That source row states the investment is a First-lien loan (EUR 910 par, due 10/2029), while the extracted maturity_date is 2024-10-31, which is before the 2024-12-31 report date. The source therefore confirms a real extraction error in the maturity date, not a false alarm.
